get.summary: Liveness
The visitor's contracts, newest first

post.description: A PDF is sent as base64 in JSON (at most 2 MB, 30 pages). The answer is the contract, queued: follow it with GET /contracts/{id}. A review takes two to five model calls (the guard, the reading and the rating, each of the last two repaired at most once) and each redline one more. The visitor may have 3 contracts reviewed a day and send 10 files; a contract that fails gives its place back, and a contract is deleted an hour after it is made.
post.summary: Review a sample contract, or a PDF the visitor sends

delete.description: Removes the file, the text, the report and the redlines at once, instead of at the end of the hour. It does not give back the visitor's place for the day.

get.description: The state moves queued, extracting, analysing, verifying, done; `failed` can follow any of them, with a code that says why. Poll this route while the review runs.
get.summary: One contract and the state of its review

get.description: As base64 inside JSON, because the site's server forwards nothing else. 409 `review_failed` when the review failed, which deletes the file at once.
get.summary: The PDF itself, for the viewer

post.description: The model proposes wording and the server computes the difference word by word. It costs one model call and one of the contract's 3 redlines; asking again for the same finding shows the redline already made and costs nothing. Not legal advice.
post.summary: A proposed change to one finding's passage

get.description: What every citation counts its characters in: a citation is a page and a range of this text. 409 `not_ready` while the review has not got as far as reading the file, and `review_failed` when it failed.
get.summary: The text of every page, as the server extracted it

get.description: Every risk finding quotes the contract, and the quote was checked against the contract's text by the server. A missing clause has no quote, and says what was searched for. Not legal advice. 409 `not_ready` while the review runs, and `review_failed` when it failed.
get.summary: The finished review

get.description: Contracts reviewed today against the daily limit (a sample counts, a file that is refused is given back), the page and size limits, how long a contract is kept, and when the day's allowance starts again.
get.summary: What is left of the visitor's day, and the limits of the system

get.description: The rules, by topic, with what each accepts and what it flags. The playbook is data the owner edits, kept outside every prompt.

get.description: Synthetic contracts, one of them hostile to a reviewer, one over the page limit and one a scan, which show what a review does and what it refuses. Reviewing one live takes one of the visitor's places for the day.
